description: Red Russian Kale is a type of kale with flat, toothed green leaves and purple stems. It can be harvested at the baby or adult stage. When harvested as a baby, it is often added to salad mixes. It is usually eaten raw or lightly cooked.
sowing_method: Direct seed indoors (and transplant after hardening off seedlings) or outdoors
